purpose: Current domain command/assertion anchors for all registered tables; postcommit coverage alone cannot prove business behavior. Run status remains in acceptance.json and raw suite output.

groups.case: creates project → assets → beat → shots, edits/duplicates/reorders and cleans relations on deletion
assertions: Saved owner IDs and field values agree with real business receipts.
Edits and reorder persist; deletions clean project relations.

groups.case: promotes independent bytes that survive source media and project deletion
assertions: Adopted media contains exact original bytes after source deletion.
Destination media has new independent ownership.

groups.case: rotates and revokes all retained identities atomically while preserving unrelated definitions
assertions: Reopening retains rotated canonical and alias values.
Deleting through an alias removes the correct definition only; late alias failure rolls back canonical and aliases.

groups.case: creates an agent, request snapshot and linked messages atomically without credentials
assertions: Stored run and linked message/thread identities are consistent.
Frozen request retains model scope and excludes credentials.

groups.case: commits nested domain writes and the ledger together and replays only the saved result
assertions: Real nested domain state and completed ledger commit together.
Replay returns the saved result without invoking a new mutation.

groups.case: creates manual tasks atomically without a connector and survives reopening the database
assertions: Reopened task and linked thread retain their exact saved identities and values.
Creating another task for the same thread returns the existing task without a duplicate.

groups.case: task_record_read returns actual append-only history with bounded text and completes its ledger atomically
assertions: Current record and immutable history retain saved versions and bounded returned text.
Actual registered tool completes its ledger with the returned history.

groups.case: CAS edits, append-only revisions, confirmed history and reopening invalidation
assertions: Stale CAS and editing confirmed history fail.
Versions remain append-only; reopening a task invalidates current summary while preserving confirmation history.

groups.case: uses a separate request and metrics, activates a summary, retains originals and reuses it
assertions: Summary activation and metrics persist; original messages remain unchanged.
Later context preparation reuses the saved compaction.

groups.case: creates, revises, disables, reactivates and deletes offline with immutable CAS history
assertions: Version bodies preserve exact ordered history.
Reopen retains active state; stale CAS fails and final deletion cascades versions.

groups.case: retains ask approval over reopen, refuses changed config before HTTP and never silently re-prepares
assertions: Changing the saved connection revision invalidates frozen approval.
Provider request does not occur after configuration mismatch.

groups.case: submits four intentional identical candidates with max two active and never replays after reopen
assertions: Actual candidate/job/result mappings persist; deterministic HTTP boundary dispatch has at most two active calls.
Reopening retains accepted task identity and does not repeat submissions.

groups.case: roundtrips source/chunks with fresh ownership and rejects tampered source bytes atomically
assertions: Imported source/chunks preserve exact text and locators under new ownership.
Tampered source bytes reject import without partial project state.

groups.case: always confirms IP creation with readable fields, commits once and never replays after a failed next request
assertions: Real confirmation gates the saved profile and completed ledger.
Retry after model failure does not create another profile.

groups.case: confirms a new project association, refreshes IP facts and permits bounded field reads afterward
assertions: Confirmed association is stored under the correct project and profile.
Subsequent facts and bounded fields reflect the linked owner.

groups.case: keeps immutable version snapshots and serializes metadata/file conflicts
assertions: Only one competing revision succeeds.
Earlier version bytes remain exact and later versions append rather than overwrite.

groups.case: pins adopted media, is idempotent and updates through a new target without rewriting old content
assertions: Repeated adoption returns the same use; updates create a new target.
Original and updated targets retain exact independent version bytes.

groups.case: requires archive and protects derivation provenance until the derived item is removed
assertions: Derivation prevents unsafe deletion.
Material history events remain after material/version cleanup.

groups.case: records actual %s project seeds and replays the exact saved receipt
assertions: Audio project receipt references the actual initial chapter/track rows.
Replay preserves the saved result and does not duplicate seeded domain rows.

groups.case: persists a receipt with real script changes and replays it without a second write
assertions: Saved segments match the returned receipt.
Replay does not create another script or ledger result.

groups.case: creates and clears a reusable MiMo speaker profile through the tool ledger
assertions: Saved reusable speaker fields agree with actual tool output.
Clearing the profile removes its optional metadata.

groups.case: round-trips all sources, codec MIME, selected references, provenance and dormant jobs
assertions: Independent source rows, selected-take IDs, exact codec MIME and provenance remap correctly.
Imported jobs retain dormant state and cannot be paid-claimed.

groups.case: splits source offsets atomically, then undoes/redoes without touching original media
assertions: Trim/source offsets and fades persist exactly.
Undo/redo restore clip count while preserving original take and media.

groups.case: retains the actual %s mix, its source fingerprint and exact WAV bytes
assertions: Chapter/project output scope, filename and current source fingerprint persist.
Verified retained WAV bytes equal actual PCM output; late association failure rolls back media and export together.

groups.case: saves a real music draft without generating work and protects engine scope
assertions: Actual saved draft settings and engine scope match the tool result.
Draft creation does not invent a generated work.

groups.case: round-trips music and copies it into audio without sharing mutable media
assertions: Imported work retains provenance under fresh ownership.
Independent audio/media copy survives deleting the original music project.

groups.case: claims one paid speech request across concurrent submits and retains a usable take
assertions: Two concurrent submits resolve to the same saved job while the real transport boundary is called only once.
Exactly one take and original media persist; the stored job excludes credentials.

groups.case: confirms only a reviewed subset with CAS, and rejects double-confirm and draft dispatch
assertions: Only one concurrent confirmation succeeds.
Actual selected items dispatch and persist saved/cancelled counts; unconfirmed draft never dispatches.

groups.case: %s performs separately approved selection and arrangement with actual receipts
assertions: Selection and placement each require real approval.
Saved proposal, selected rows, timeline additions and completed receipts agree.

groups.case: restores shot and proposal when the final applied proposal persistence fails
assertions: Late failure sees actual changed shot inside the UoW.
Reopen restores the original shot and pending proposal atomically.
